scope: Historical NLH v2/TWSC simplified model versus current model; not implementation-equivalence evidence

profiles.attribution: Explicit sigma only. Verified dirty-baseline archive always runs one Basic stage followed by one Wiener stage, including when rclip is absent. Current resolves iterative Basic and fixed-Basic repeated Wiener v5 presets. Both normalize API sigma by 255 with no BM3D 0.75 factor; equal sigma does not imply equal denoising response or restoration semantics.

Common public block, step, group, range, q and radius. Current broadcasts shape to both stages and retains its own rounds/calibration/all-selected-pixel aggregation. Geometry equality does not imply identical matches, work or mathematics.

Explicit sigma only. Legacy b8/step8/g8/iters2 simplified shrinkage differs from current sigma-dependent dense groups, full three-weight objective, dictionary decomposition and ADMM. Both normalize API sigma by 255 with no BM3D 0.75 factor; equal sigma does not imply equal denoising response.

Common legal public geometry and shared controls, including lambda2=3 and delta=.1. Their interpretation and the solver objective remain model-specific. Current retains its ADMM default10; legacy has no public admm_iter and uses a different shrinkage route.
